Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Yes—if your order hasn’t shipped, you can request a cancellation. There’s no fixed cancellation window; please request it as soon as possible. We can’t guarantee cancellation once the order is being packed, and an order that has shipped can’t be canceled. Personalized items can’t be canceled once personalization is complete.
